subject: EVQA status: baseline at 44.1%, retrieval quality is the ceiling
body:
Hi Priya, Daniela,

Status on the June 12 baseline milestone (three days late, apologies - index rebuild ate the buffer).

Our retrieval-augmented baseline scores 44.1% on the single-hop single-answer split, against the published 48.8% for the Lens-augmented reference and 13.0% for the no-retrieval SOTA VLM. The gap to 48.8 is almost entirely retrieval quality: with oracle retrieval (gold evidence passage injected) the same reader hits 61.7%, so the reader is fine and our entity-linking recall (top-5 at 71%) is the ceiling.

Risks: (1) two-hop questions remain far below usable - we're at 9%, and I recommend keeping them out of product scope entirely; (2) Jorge's KB index rebuilds take 14 hours, which makes retrieval iteration slow; he has a sharding plan to get it under 4.

Yara's distillation recipe: first student run recovers 91% of teacher accuracy at roughly one-eighth the serving cost. Details in the doc.

Vera
